arguments.content:
I need to determine when the longest bridge in the world was opened.

The longest bridge in the world is the **Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge** in China, which is part of the Beijing–Shanghai High-Speed Railway. This bridge holds the Guinness World Record for the longest bridge at approximately 164.8 kilometers (102.4 miles).

The bridge was opened in **2011**.2011
